purpose: Distinguish persistent partial de-risking from rebuilding allocation after price recovery, within the original five-session cycle.

anchors.label: EX045_RAMP_LINEAR_ADAPTED

anchors.label: EX045_HARD_LINEAR_QUALIFIED

point_set.fixed_within_anchor: All parameters except exit_policy and the three trail_atr multipliers.
point_set.duplicates: Deduplicate identical effective parameter configurations across anchors; explicitly record reused control identities and completed coverage. No substitute parameters chosen to fill the nominal count.
point_set.center_control_parity: At the first two anchors, ramp center matches its prior economic path; at the optional third anchor, hard center matches its prior economic path. These controls pass before remaining variants.
point_set.scope: At most 27 mechanism-comparison configurations before deduplication; original formal 80% neighbor protocol remains separate.

matched_comparisons: ramp_rebuild minus ramp at identical anchor/ATR
ramp_rebuild minus hard at identical anchor/ATR
ramp minus hard retained as existing-mechanism context
whole_path: actual fills, cash fees, turnover, and exposure
number of cycles with fraction increases while active
actual buys linked to fraction increases separated from constant-target rebalancing
full-zero exits remaining latched until confirmed close
timing and returns of harmed as well as improved cycles
evaluation.counterexample_role: Report alongside the full cycle population; these dates were already examined and do not govern trading rules or anchor selection.
adverse_hypotheses: Rebuilding buys after price rises, followed by another sell during oscillation, increasing loss and fees.
Recovery in a short cycle reverses again and raises MDD.
Any improvement is concentrated in one previously noticed rebound while other years or cycles deteriorate.
Parameter sensitivity persists or increases despite higher central NAR.

decision_guidance: If rebuilding improves the matched net path and original target attainment with acceptable losses across complete cycles, retain it for subsequent parameter research or approved self-check.
If the full matched path loses after costs, MDD worsens materially, or only an isolated known rebound improves, keep the counterevidence and deprioritize this expression.
Treat three-point sensitivity as mechanism evidence; formal stage-four qualification follows its approved full protocol.

implementation_validation.method: Synthetic actual step calls, exact old-source restoration, public StrategyStateSchema validation; no account replay.
